text:
maria: Heads up — planning to bump console to v1.14.0 tomorrow AM. Need docs + SDK regen coordinated. Deploy window 09:30-10:30 PT. Can docs team confirm they can run docsite publish and the SDK regen job pre-cutoff?

devon: pinging @kai @samir — is the changelog locked in PR #4523? any types/build blockers I should know about?

kai: I can run the SDK regen after branch cut. Changelog is drafted in the PR but needs an approve. Quick Q: should examples be pinned to 1.14.0 or use `latest` tag? I'd prefer pinning to avoid surprise diffs.

samir: I'll add an entry about the new CLI batching flag to the changelog now. Also adding a short migration note. @maria what's our code-freeze cutoff?

maria: Cutoff is 08:00 PT. Branch cut at 08:05, then release-bot tags rc at 08:10. Docs publish should happen after branch cut + smoke. SDK regen must reference rc/v1.14.0 tag. If anything lands after cutoff it goes in the next patch.

release-bot: release-bot: Reminder — branch cut scheduled 08:05 PT. Tagging will fail if tests don't pass. Checklist: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/release-checklist

docs-ci: docs-ci: I'll queue a preview build as soon as changelog PR merges. Expect preview ~7m. If changelog updates land after preview, post the final manifest here so I can rerun.

devon: I'll approve the changelog in ~10m and add a tiny docs snippet describing the batching param. Leaving the snippet in the PR body so docs-ci picks it up.

kai: SDK regen command for whoever runs it: ```
# from monorepo root
./scripts/regen-sdk.sh --tag rc/v1.14.0 --output /tmp/sdk-docs
# then open PR to docs repo with generated files
```

samir: quick note — I'll be offline 09:15-09:45 PT for a meeting but will try to merge before then. If I'm blocked, @devon please merge the changelog + examples fix.

maria: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone. I'll pin this thread and update the release tracker + calendar invite. If we hit blockers, fallback plan is to hold to v1.13.x for the deploy and cut a follow-up. Post any final manifests/preview links in this thread so QA can smoke test before 09:30.
